brief:
Israeli forces fired live ammunition at two children during a raid on the Am'ari refugee camp in el-Bireh, the occupied West Bank, on Tuesday, Al Jazeera reported. One of the children sustained serious wounds from the gunfire.

The incident took place as Israeli military personnel conducted operations within the refugee camp. The circumstances surrounding the raid and the medical condition of the second child shot were not immediately detailed in initial reports of the confrontation.

title: Israeli forces shoot two children in West Bank raid
